step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Aqua Security's Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) integration with a customer's AWS environment. Aqua SaaS (ThirdParty) communicates bidirectionally through a Network Load Balancer (NLB) deployed in the customer's VPC. The NLB routes traffic to Amazon EKS worker nodes deployed across two private subnets in distinct Availability Zones (AZ 1 and AZ 2). Each EKS node hosts both application containers and an Aqua daemonset agent running alongside to provide real-time runtime monitoring, threat detection, and process blocking.
